name: Simple Layout
author: wssst
description: Clean and simple, with a full keyboard and a command page; great for regular players. Includes some mod keys (updated from time to time), and control groups are clearly labeled - extend it yourself if you know how; "Key styles use bedjava by XiaoluoFoxington on bilibili"

buttonList.text: Double-tap ESC to open the console

Key style reference:
bilibili
XiaoluoFoxington's bedjava
This section introduces the extra functions of some keys
Tapping "Keyboard" is the control group that opens the input method; the "Keyboard" button turns dark when the input method is actually open
Pressing "shift" performs shift, while tapping "shift" holds shift

To avoid key conflicts, some keys have been changed; please go to Key Bindings to assign input. With too many mods, it is best to set unnecessary or rarely used keys to Unassigned
(click the key you want to change and press ESC to set it to Unassigned)
Each preset provides a starting key set; you are advised to adjust key positions yourself. Every preset can be found at the end of its key group
